## 9. v2 side by side (NOT like-for-like)

v2 meta fusion: 95.23% accuracy at 1.06% FA (../codes_v2/results/fusion.json (meta fusion, 2% val budget)): one row per domain drawn independently per SAMPLE, 50% all-normal mix, a supervised meta-classifier trained on the attack classes it is tested on, random halves for CAN / network.
v3 composite view (50% clean composites / 50% attacked composites, composite = whole drive of 8-45 s (K) / 120 s (C), an alarm anywhere in a clean composite is a false composite):

- K: accuracy 68.8%, composite FA 44.5%, composite detection 82.1% (n = 4000).
- C: accuracy 55.1%, composite FA 83.6%, composite detection 93.9% (n = 2000).
